status.stun.desc: Loses actions until the effect expires.

status.bleed.desc: Takes physical damage at turn start and stacks independently.

status.mana_surge_buff.desc: A temporary mana-oriented buff that refreshes duration.

status.devotion_buff.desc: A faith buff that refreshes duration instead of stacking.
status.holy_aura_buff.desc: A persistent holy aura buff that refreshes duration.

keyword.armor_break.name: Armor Break
keyword.armor_break.tooltip: Reduces defense and makes follow-up hits more effective.
keyword.bleed.name: Bleed
keyword.bleed.tooltip: A damage-over-time effect that keeps ticking until it expires.
keyword.burn.name: Burn
keyword.burn.tooltip: Fire damage over time that refreshes rather than stacking into a separate rule path.
keyword.freeze.name: Freeze
keyword.freeze.tooltip: Cold control that locks the target down until the effect ends or is overwritten.
keyword.stun.name: Stun
keyword.stun.tooltip: Prevents the target from acting for the listed duration.
keyword.shield.name: Shield
keyword.shield.tooltip: A defensive effect that increases survivability without changing core HP semantics.
keyword.penetration.name: Penetration
keyword.penetration.tooltip: Pushes damage through mitigation more reliably.
keyword.diminishing_returns.name: Diminishing Returns
keyword.diminishing_returns.tooltip: Repeated control or stacking effects lose value if you try to loop them endlessly.
keyword.power_save.name: Power Save
keyword.power_save.tooltip: Uses the talent's power dimension when the target gets a resistance save.
keyword.telegraph.name: Telegraph
keyword.telegraph.tooltip: A preview that exposes an upcoming hostile action before it resolves.
keyword.crit.name: Critical
keyword.crit.tooltip: A high-roll hit that amplifies the final damage result.
keyword.dot.name: Damage Over Time
keyword.dot.tooltip: Keeps dealing damage across future turns instead of only on cast.
keyword.sustain.name: Sustain
keyword.sustain.tooltip: A longer-running talent pattern that trades burst for persistent value.
keyword.cleanse.name: Cleanse
keyword.cleanse.tooltip: Removes negative effects without rewriting the source status contract.
keyword.dispel.name: Dispel
keyword.dispel.tooltip: Strips an effect off a target through the status engine's normal rules.
keyword.damage.name: Damage
keyword.damage.tooltip: Directly lowers the target's HP through the combat pipeline.
keyword.movement.name: Movement
keyword.movement.tooltip: Changes position as part of the talent's resolved effect.
keyword.single_target.name: Single Target
keyword.single_target.tooltip: Affects one primary target rather than an area.
keyword.area.name: Area
keyword.area.tooltip: Affects multiple tiles or targets in a radius or pattern.
keyword.buff.name: Buff
keyword.buff.tooltip: Improves the acting unit with a positive timed effect.
keyword.cleave.name: Cleave
keyword.cleave.tooltip: Hits multiple nearby enemies off one action.
keyword.control.name: Control
keyword.control.tooltip: Limits enemy actions, movement, or effective response windows.
keyword.counter.name: Counter
keyword.counter.tooltip: Converts a guarded exchange into a short defensive answer or clean follow-up.
keyword.curse.name: Curse
keyword.curse.tooltip: A persistent debuff that drags down offense or defense.
keyword.debuff.name: Debuff
keyword.debuff.tooltip: Applies a negative state to weaken the target.
keyword.defense.name: Defense
keyword.defense.tooltip: Improves mitigation or staying power rather than raw output.
keyword.finisher.name: Finisher
keyword.finisher.tooltip: A payoff talent that becomes stronger once setup or target state is favorable.
keyword.heal.name: Heal
keyword.heal.tooltip: Restores lost HP through the healing pipeline.
keyword.holy.name: Holy
keyword.holy.tooltip: Uses the holy damage channel and related interactions.
keyword.knockback.name: Knockback
keyword.knockback.tooltip: Pushes the target away if space allows.
keyword.mobility.name: Mobility
keyword.mobility.tooltip: Creates or denies distance as part of the action.
keyword.panic.name: Panic
keyword.panic.tooltip: An emergency stabilizer meant for bad turns or low margin states.
keyword.ranged.name: Ranged
keyword.ranged.tooltip: Can be used beyond adjacent melee distance.
keyword.reposition.name: Reposition
keyword.reposition.tooltip: Moves the actor to a more favorable tile without changing core movement rules.
keyword.resource.name: Resource
keyword.resource.tooltip: Consumes or restores a tracked profession resource.
keyword.slow.name: Slow
keyword.slow.tooltip: Reduces pace, initiative, or practical threat windows.

objective.greenwood_signal_hunt.name: Break The Greenwood Patrol
objective.greenwood_signal_hunt.desc: Cut the patrol web, raid the hidden cache, and force a path through the fringe.
objective.greenwood_signal_hunt.step.tra: The hidden trail cache is open and the patrol line is exposed.
objective.greenwood_signal_hunt.step.war: The beacon burns and every hunter nearby is on your trail.
objective.greenwood_signal_hunt.step.hun: The trap line is severed and the route opens deeper into the woods.
objective.bandit_camp_cache_raid.name: Raid The Bandit Cache
objective.bandit_camp_cache_raid.desc: Break the ambush lane, loot the hidden cache, and pull back with route control intact.
objective.bandit_camp_cache_raid.step.ca: The cache is broken open and the camp's pressure line is disrupted.
objective.deep_iron_pit_forge_run.name: Seize The Furnace Route
objective.deep_iron_pit_forge_run.desc: Push through the mine pressure, seize the furnace, and claim the forge road.
objective.deep_iron_pit_forge_run.step.o: The ore stash is broken open for the forward push.
objective.deep_iron_pit_forge_run.step.s: The slag channels burst and the pit erupts into full alarm.
objective.deep_iron_pit_forge_run.step.f: The furnace line is under your control and the way onward is stable.
objective.elven_ruins_relic_ward.name: Claim The Relic Ward
objective.elven_ruins_relic_ward.desc: Clear the ruin pressure, secure the wardstone, and withdraw with the relic line stabilized.
objective.elven_ruins_relic_ward.step.wa: The wardstone answers to you and the ruin's relic current settles.
objective.grey_gate_seal_rite.name: Break The Grey Seals
objective.grey_gate_seal_rite.desc: Strip the gate of its last rites, raid the seal cache, and force entry to the lord's chamber.
objective.molten_core_pressure.name: Stabilize The Molten Core
objective.molten_core_pressure.desc: Hold the forge path, bleed off the heat, and leave the core under control.
objective.molten_core_pressure.step.pres: The core pressure is stabilized and the forge route stops spiraling out of control.
objective.underground_river_crossing.des: Hold the crossing, read the currents, and secure passage to the temple route.
objective.underground_river_crossing.ste: The ferry anchor is secured and the current line can be crossed safely.
objective.crystal_cavern_resonance.name: Tune The Crystal Cavern
objective.crystal_cavern_resonance.desc: Attune the resonance node, quiet the shard drift, and leave with the cavern route mapped.
The resonance node is attuned and the shard current settles into a readable pattern.
objective.abyssal_temple_sanctum.name: Sanctify The Abyssal Temple
objective.abyssal_temple_sanctum.desc: Break the temple pressure and claim the final road into the heart.
objective.abyssal_temple_sanctum.step.wa: The ward reliquary is under your control and the temple line holds.
objective.abyssal_heart_finale.name: End The Abyssal Heart
objective.abyssal_heart_finale.desc: Defeat the guardian and finish the long-run route.
objective.abyssal_heart_finale.step.ward: The heart ward focus flares and the chamber steadies for the final exchange.

zone.mechanic_hint.tutorial_ruins: Use the breach props to steady your opening push before the captain.
zone.mechanic_hint.forest_patrol: Patrol pressure is light until you trip the warning line or raid the route cache.
zone.mechanic_hint.mine_forge: Forge pressure ramps fast once valves and furnace lanes are contested.
zone.mechanic_hint.sealed_depths: Later routes are sealed behind rituals, crossings, and ward control.
zone.mechanic_hint.patrol_pressure: Route patrols will reinforce the floor if you stall for too long outside the boss push.
zone.mechanic_hint.ambush_lane: The bandit camp rewards a fast cache raid before the ambush net closes.
zone.mechanic_hint.furnace_pressure: Furnace pressure cycles between warning heat and active burn lanes every few turns.
zone.mechanic_hint.lore_cache: The ruins hide a relic ward that trades safety for a slower, cleaner clear.
zone.mechanic_hint.ore_cart: Mine lanes stay open longer if you break the furnace route in sequence.
zone.mechanic_hint.lava_pockets: Molten pockets punish over-extended fights unless the pressure valve is stabilized.
zone.mechanic_hint.sealed_gate: The grey gate only opens cleanly after the ritual line is broken.
zone.mechanic_hint.currents: The river crossing is unsafe until the ferry anchor is secured.
zone.mechanic_hint.crystal_shards: Crystal drift becomes manageable once the resonance node is attuned.
zone.mechanic_hint.abyssal_ward: The temple's final route stays unstable until the ward reliquary is claimed.
zone.mechanic_hint.finale: Stabilize the ward focus before committing to the guardian's last phase.
log.zone.patrol_pressure.wave: Patrol pressure rises as {count} reinforcements enter the floor.
log.zone.ambush_lane.triggered: The ambush lane snaps shut and {count} hostiles surge from the side rooms.
log.zone.furnace_pressure.telegraph: The furnace line starts to vent heat through the marked cells.
log.zone.furnace_pressure.active: The furnace line erupts and the marked cells begin to burn.
log.zone.currents.drag: The river current drags you sideways across the crossing lane.
log.zone.currents.safe_lane: The ferry anchor bites deep and a stable crossing lane opens through the current.
log.zone.crystal_shards.telegraph: The cavern starts to hum as crystal shards gather beneath the marked cells.
log.zone.crystal_shards.active: Crystal shards erupt from the marked cells and turn the lane hostile.
log.zone.crystal_shards.settled: The resonance node settles the shard drift and the cavern's pressure drops.
log.zone.void_pressure.telegraph: Void pressure starts to gather across the temple lane and the marked cells begin to pulse.
log.zone.void_pressure.active: The ward line buckles and void pressure floods the marked temple cells.
log.zone.void_pressure.stabilized: The reliquary answers your touch and a steadier ward corridor opens through the temple.
log.zone.void_eruption.telegraph: The heart chamber tightens as a fresh void eruption starts to form around the marked cells.
log.zone.void_eruption.active: Void eruptions lash through the chamber and the marked cells become unsafe.
log.zone.void_eruption.stabilized: The ward focus narrows the heart pressure and buys a short calm before the guardian.

monster.river.hook_lurker.name: Hook Lurker
monster.river.hook_lurker.desc: A bank-side ambusher waiting to drag prey off the ferry path.
monster.river.drowned_stalker.name: Drowned Stalker
monster.river.drowned_stalker.desc: A waterlogged hunter slipping in and out of sight along the flooded edge.
monster.river.tide_mender.name: Tide Mender
monster.river.tide_mender.desc: A channeler stabilizing the river line while allies buy time upstream.
monster.river.ferry_raider.name: Ferry Raider
monster.river.ferry_raider.desc: A boarding raider who crashes onto the crossing when the player commits.
monster.river.current_reaver.name: Current Reaver
monster.river.current_reaver.desc: An elite river predator that uses flow and angle to finish weakened targets.
monster.river.silt_shaman.name: Silt Shaman
monster.river.silt_shaman.desc: A murk caster turning the riverbed into a slowing, dirty kill lane.
monster.river.undertow_brute.name: Undertow Brute
monster.river.undertow_brute.desc: A heavy brute whose momentum is hardest to stop near the fast current.
monster.abyssal.ward_breaker.name: Ward Breaker
monster.abyssal.ward_breaker.desc: A temple shock trooper trained to crack sanctum defenses head-on.
monster.abyssal.ritual_binder.name: Ritual Binder
monster.abyssal.ritual_binder.desc: A binding priest who turns open space into a ritual cage.
monster.abyssal.cleanse_hunter.name: Cleanse Hunter
monster.abyssal.cleanse_hunter.desc: A hunter built to punish buff-heavy builds inside the temple approach.
monster.abyssal.void_preacher.name: Void Preacher
monster.abyssal.void_preacher.desc: A preacher of the heart chamber pressing the run with void-drenched sermons.
monster.abyssal.reliquary_guard.name: Reliquary Guard
monster.abyssal.reliquary_guard.desc: An elite temple guard set to keep the ward reliquary alive at all costs.
monster.abyssal.null_lancer.name: Null Lancer
monster.abyssal.null_lancer.desc: A precision lancer holding the final approach with cold, empty discipline.
monster.abyssal.eclipsed_seraph.name: Eclipsed Seraph
monster.abyssal.eclipsed_seraph.desc: A fallen radiant enforcer recast as the temple's late-game executioner.
talent.vanguard.linebreaker.name: Linebreaker
talent.vanguard.linebreaker.desc: Drive through the front and crack open space for the follow-up swing.
talent.vanguard.earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
talent.vanguard.earthshaker.desc: Hammer the ground to punish clustered melee and halt a push.
talent.vanguard.bulwark_march.name: Bulwark March
talent.vanguard.bulwark_march.desc: Advance behind your guard and keep the line from collapsing.
talent.vanguard.battlefield_command.name: Battlefield Command
talent.vanguard.battlefield_command.desc: Issue a disciplined call that sharpens your next exchange.
talent.arcanist.cinder_burst.name: Cinder Burst
talent.arcanist.cinder_burst.desc: Detonate a close fire answer that leaves lingering burn pressure.
talent.arcanist.inferno_orb.name: Inferno Orb
talent.arcanist.inferno_orb.desc: Launch a heavier fire orb to punish lanes that stay crowded.
talent.arcanist.glacial_seal.name: Glacial Seal
talent.arcanist.glacial_seal.desc: Lock a target or chokepoint under a cold control window.
talent.arcanist.shard_storm.name: Shard Storm
talent.arcanist.shard_storm.desc: Fan razor shards through the lane to slow and soften the pack.
talent.arcanist.void_breach.name: Void Breach
talent.arcanist.void_breach.desc: Open a volatile arcane breach that forces a real late-game answer.
talent.rogue.crippling_strike.name: Crippling Strike
talent.rogue.crippling_strike.desc: Open on a target by cutting its tempo and escape window.
talent.rogue.eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
talent.rogue.eviscerate.desc: Commit to a brutal finisher when the kill window finally appears.
talent.rogue.shadow_bind.name: Shadow Bind
talent.rogue.shadow_bind.desc: Pin a target in place long enough to decide the exchange.
talent.rogue.dusk_shroud.name: Dusk Shroud
talent.rogue.dusk_shroud.desc: Wrap yourself in brief cover and reset the pace on demand.
talent.rogue.ricochet_knives.name: Ricochet Knives
talent.rogue.ricochet_knives.desc: Throw knives that keep pressure bouncing through the pack.
talent.templar.radiant_lance.name: Radiant Lance
talent.templar.radiant_lance.desc: Drive a focused holy answer through a priority target.
talent.templar.consecration.name: Consecration
talent.templar.consecration.desc: Claim the ground with a holy field that punishes anyone standing in it.
talent.templar.sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
talent.templar.sanctuary.desc: Raise a short defensive refuge before the next heavy trade.
talent.templar.absolution.name: Absolution
talent.templar.absolution.desc: Strip hostile pressure and stabilize the next action window.
talent.templar.beacon_of_zeal.name: Beacon of Zeal
talent.templar.beacon_of_zeal.desc: Plant a holy signal that keeps your momentum and devotion online.
talent.templar.ritual_break.name: Ritual Break
talent.templar.ritual_break.desc: Shatter hostile ritual tempo before it snowballs out of control.
